logger.doc:name: Log Request Received
logger.message: #['REQUEST RECEIVED correlationId=' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' method=' ++ attributes.method ++ ' path=' ++ attributes.requestPath]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, validationStatus: "INVALID", status: "INVALID_REQUEST", errorCode: "APIKIT_BAD_REQUEST", message: "Request validation failed.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, validationReasons: [{ code: "REQUEST_INVALID", message: error.description default "Bad request", category: "INPUT", retryable: false }] }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, validationStatus: "INVALID", status: "NOT_FOUND", errorCode: "APIKIT_NOT_FOUND", message: "Resource not found", correlationId: vars.correlationId, validationReasons: [{ code: "RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND", message: "Resource not found", category: "INPUT", retryable: false }] }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, validationStatus: "INVALID", status: "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", errorCode: "APIKIT_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", message: "Method not allowed", correlationId: vars.correlationId, validationReasons: [{ code: "METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED", message: "Method not allowed", category: "INPUT", retryable: false }] }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, validationStatus: "INVALID", status: "NOT_ACCEPTABLE", errorCode: "APIKIT_NOT_ACCEPTABLE", message: "Not acceptable", correlationId: vars.correlationId, validationReasons: [{ code: "NOT_ACCEPTABLE", message: "Not acceptable", category: "INPUT", retryable: false }] }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, validationStatus: "INVALID", status: "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE", errorCode: "APIKIT_UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE", message: "Unsupported media type. Use application/json.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, validationReasons: [{ code: "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE", message: "Content-Type must be application/json", field: "Content-Type", category: "INPUT", retryable: false }] }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, validationStatus: "INVALID", status: "NOT_IMPLEMENTED", errorCode: "APIKIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED", message: "Not implemented", correlationId: vars.correlationId, validationReasons: [{ code: "NOT_IMPLEMENTED", message: "Not implemented", category: "TECHNICAL", retryable: false }] }

logger.message: #['PROCESS API UNAVAILABLE correlationId=' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' error=' ++ (error.description default 'n/a')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, validationStatus: "INVALID", status: "SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", errorCode: "PROCESS_API_UNAVAILABLE", message: "A required service is temporarily unavailable. Please retry.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, validationReasons: [{ code: "DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE", message: "Process API is not reachable or timed out", category: "TECHNICAL", retryable: true }] }

logger.message: #['UNEXPECTED ERROR correlationId=' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' type=' ++ (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '') ++ ' description=' ++ (error.description default 'n/a')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, validationStatus: "INVALID", status: "INTERNAL_ERROR", errorCode: "UNEXPECTED_ERROR", message: "An unexpected error occurred. Quote the correlationId when reporting it.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, validationReasons: [{ code: "UNEXPECTED_ERROR", message: "Unexpected processing failure", category: "TECHNICAL", retryable: false }] }

logger.doc:name: Log Validation Result
logger.message: #['VALIDATED correlationId=' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' batchId=' ++ (vars.validation.batchId default 'n/a') ++ ' events=' ++ (sizeOf(vars.validation.items) as String) ++ ' validForProcessing=' ++ (vars.validation.validCount as String) ++ ' batchErrors=' ++ (sizeOf(vars.validation.batchErrors) as String)]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { valid: false, validationStatus: "INVALID", status: "INVALID_REQUEST", errorCode: "INVALID_BATCH_REQUEST", message: vars.validation.batchErrors[0].message, correlationId: vars.correlationId, validationReasons: vars.validation.batchErrors }
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { sourceSystem: vars.validation.sourceSystem, batchId: vars.validation.batchId, events: vars.validation.validEvents }

logger.doc:name: No valid events
logger.message: #['NO VALID EVENTS correlationId=' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' - Process API not called']

logger.doc:name: Log Response Summary
logger.message: #[output application/java --- 'COMPLETED correlationId=' ++ vars.correlationId ++ ' batchId=' ++ (payload.batchId default 'n/a') ++ ' processed=' ++ (payload.processedCount as String) ++ ' accepted=' ++ (payload.acceptedCount as String) ++ ' stale=' ++ (payload.staleCount as String) ++ ' rejected=' ++ (payload.rejectedCount as String) ++ ' duplicate=' ++ (payload.duplicateCount as String) ++ ' conflict=' ++ (payload.conflictCount as String) ++ ' failed=' ++ (payload.failedCount as String)]

set-variable.doc:name: Set recipients
set-variable.value: #[([Mule::p('mail.owner'), Mule::p('mail.warehouse'), Mule::p('mail.fulfilment'), payload.customerEmail] filter (($ default '') != '')) distinctBy $]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { sent: false, error: "No recipients configured (set mail.owner in config.properties)" }

%dw 2.0 output text/plain fun esc(s) = ((s default "") as String) replace "&" with "&" replace "<" with "<" replace ">" with ">" fun lowTag(l) = if (l.lowStock == true) " - LOW STOCK" else "" fun reasonTxt(l) = (l.reasonCode default "") ++ (if (l.reason != null) (": " ++ l.reason) else "") fun pub(l) = (l.publishedTo default []) joinBy ", " var rows = (payload.lines default []) map (l) -> '$(esc(l.eventId))$(esc(l.sku))$(esc(l.locationCode))$(esc(l.movementType))' ++ '$(esc(l.eventVersion))$(esc(l.eventTimestamp))' ++ '$(esc(l.quantityOnHand))$(esc(l.reservedQuantity))$(esc(l.availableQuantity default "-"))' ++ '$(esc(l.unitOfMeasure))$(esc(l.referenceDocument))' ++ '$(esc(l.outcome))$(esc(lowTag(l)))$(esc(reasonTxt(l)))$(esc(pub(l)))' --- '

Inventory Update Invoice $(esc(payload.invoiceNo))

' ++ '

Date: $(esc(payload.date))
Source system: $(esc(payload.sourceSystem))
Batch ID: $(esc(payload.batchId))
Correlation ID: $(esc(payload.correlationId))
HTTP status: $(esc(payload.httpStatus))

' ++ '' ++ (rows joinBy "") ++ '
Event IDSKULocationTypeVersionEvent timestampOn handReservedAvailableUoMReferenceOutcomeReasonPublished to
' ++ '

Processed $(esc(payload.counts.processed)) | Accepted $(esc(payload.counts.accepted)) | Stale $(esc(payload.counts.stale)) | Rejected $(esc(payload.counts.rejected)) | Duplicate $(esc(payload.counts.duplicate)) | Conflict $(esc(payload.counts.conflict)) | Retry pending $(esc(payload.counts.retryPending)) | Failed $(esc(payload.counts.failed))

' ++ '

Request sent

$(esc(payload.requestJson))
' ++ '

Full response

$(esc(payload.responseJson))
'
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { sent: true, to: vars.recipients }

logger.doc:name: Log Email Failure
logger.message: #['INVOICE EMAIL FAILED invoice=' ++ (vars.invoiceNo default '') ++ ' reason=' ++ (error.description default '')]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { sent: false, error: error.description default "Email failed" }
